title: Camps C8 + C9 (+ C16 Restore) — the camper’s ⋯ menu
subtitle: C8 (rule v1.011, Color Belt’s order): three groups with a line between — about the person (Edit details first, Change how they’ll pay, Review), money (Edit payment, Undo payment; Print receipt comes later with C3), taking someone off (Withdraw, then Delete permanently, last and red). Items that don’t apply are left out. C9 (v1.012): no “Admin” heading — staff don’t see what they can never do; admins see the whole menu. C16: Restore gets ti-arrow-back-up. PC 1280×800, switch off. Touch screens list the same items under “More” in Camper detail (Edit details is the blue button there), in the same order. Amber = the changed menu.

footer: To settle: (1) The item stays “Review” (the app’s word today); 10a’s list calls it “Review possible duplicate” — say if the menu should use the longer words. (2) Change how they’ll pay has no icon in Camps; v1.024 gives that meaning ti-switch-horizontal for Color Belt, Star and Black Belt but doesn’t name Camps — recommendation: follow the map (not drawn). (3) Nothing in a Camps camper menu is “can do, but not right now” for staff, so no grayed “Ask an admin” line appears here; the one in Camps is the camp menu’s Open sign-up after the closing date (picture 6). (4) Touch “More” today shows only items that aren’t grayed; with no “Admin” label its buttons just follow this order in one wrapping row. Script: mock-c08-menu.js.
